an5.194:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane Kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an5.194:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Kāraṇapālī brāhmaṇo Licchavīnaṃ kammantaṃ kāreti.
an5.194:1.3: Addasā kho Kāraṇapālī brāhmaṇo Piṅgiyāniṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dūrato 'va āgacchantaṃ,
an5.194:2.1: ‘Handa kuto nu bhavaṃ Piṅgiyānī āgacchati divādivassā' ti?
an5.194:2.2: ‘Ito 'haṃ bho āgacchāmi samaṇassa Gotamassa santikā' ti.
an5.194:2.3: ‘Taṃ kiṃ maññati bhavaṃ Piṅgiyānī samaṇassa Gotamassa paññāveyyattiyaṃ, paṇḍito maññe' ti?
an5.194:2.4: ‘Ko cāhaṃ bho, ko ca samaṇassa Gotamassa paññāveyyattiyaṃ jānissāmi?
an5.194:2.5: So pi nūn'assa tādiso 'va, yo samaṇassa Gotamassa paññāveyyattiyaṃ jāneyyā' ti.
an5.194:2.6: ‘Uḷārāya khalu bhavaṃ Piṅgiyānī samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ pasaṃsāya pasaṃsatī' ti.
an5.194:2.7: ‘Ko cāhaṃ bho, ko ca samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ pasaṃsissāmi?
an5.194:2.8: Pasatthapasattho 'va so bhavaṃ Gotamo seṭṭho devamanussānan' ti.
an5.194:2.9: ‘Kiṃ pana bhavaṃ Piṅgiyānī atthavasaṃ sampassamāno samaṇe Gotame evaṃ abhippasanno' ti?
an5.194:3.1: ‘Seyyathā pi bho puriso aggarasaparititto na aññesaṃ hīnānaṃ rasānaṃ piheti,
an5.194:3.2: evam eva kho bho yato yato tassa bhoto Gotamassa dhammaṃ suṇāti
an5.194:3.3: yadi suttaso yadi geyyaso yadi veyyākaraṇaso yadi abbhutadhammaso,
an5.194:3.4: tato tato na aññesaṃ puthusamaṇabrāhmaṇappavādānaṃ piheti.
an5.194:4.1: Seyyathā pi bho puriso jighacchādubbalyapareto madhupiṇḍikaṃ adhigaccheyya,
an5.194:4.2: so yato yato sāyetha, labhat'eva sādu rasaṃ asecanakaṃ,
an5.194:4.3: evam eva kho bho yato yato tassa bhoto Gotamassa dhammaṃ suṇāti
an5.194:4.4: yadi suttaso yadi geyyaso yadi veyyākaraṇaso yadi abbhutadhammaso,
an5.194:4.5: tato tato labhat'eva attamanataṃ labhati cetaso pasādaṃ.
an5.194:5.1: Seyyathā pi bho puriso candanaghaṭikaṃ adhigaccheyya
an5.194:5.4: yadi mūlato yadi majjhato yadi aggato,
an5.194:5.6: evam eva kho bho yato yato tassa bhoto Gotamassa dhammaṃ suṇāti
an5.194:5.7: yadi suttaso yadi geyyaso yadi veyyākaraṇaso yadi abbhutadhammaso,
an5.194:5.8: tato tato adhigacchati pāmujjaṃ adhigacchati somanassaṃ.
an5.194:6.1: Seyyathā pi bho puriso ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno,
an5.194:6.2: tassa kusalo bhisakko ṭhānaso ābādhaṃ nīhareyya,
an5.194:6.3: evam eva kho bho yato yato tassa bhoto Gotamassa dhammaṃ suṇāti
an5.194:6.4: yadi suttaso yadi geyyaso yadi veyyākaraṇaso yadi abbhutadhammaso,
an5.194:7.1: Seyyathā pi bho pokkharaṇī acchodakā sātodakā sītodakā setodakā supatiṭṭhā ramaṇīyā,
an5.194:7.2: atha puriso āgaccheyya ghammābhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito,
an5.194:7.3: so taṃ pokkharaṇiṃ ogāhetvā nhātvā ca pivitvā ca sabbadarathakilamathapariḷāhaṃ paṭippassambheyya,
an5.194:7.4: evam eva kho bho yato yato tassa bhoto Gotamassa dhammaṃ suṇāti
an5.194:7.5: yadi suttaso yadi geyyaso yadi veyyākaraṇaso yadi abbhutadhammaso,
an5.194:8.1: Evaṃ vutte Karaṇapālī brāhmaṇo uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā dakkhiṇajānumaṇḍalaṃ paṭhaviyaṃ nihantvā yena Bhagavā ten' añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā tikkhattuṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
an5.194:12.2: Seyyathā pi bho Piṅgiyāni nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telappajjotaṃ dhāreyya "cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantī" ti, evam eva bhotā Piṅgiyaninā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
an5.194:12.3: Esāhaṃ bho Piṅgiyāni taṃ bhavantaṃ Gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṅghañ ca,
an5.194:12.4: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ Piṅgiyānī dhāretu ajja-t-agge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan'
